name: pharmacypos
description: Pharmacy billing & inventory for Indian medical stores (GST, batch/expiry, Schedule H1)

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace server && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.demo: npm run build && npm run seed && npm start
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify:api && npm run verify:ui && node e2e/verify-new-features.mjs && node e2e/verify-hold-and-dues.mjs && node e2e/verify-import-and-golive.mjs && node e2e/verify-doctor-and-upload.mjs && node e2e/verify-invoice-scan.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace web
scripts.verify:desktop: npm run build && xvfb-run -a node e2e/verify-desktop.mjs
scripts.verify:desktop:packaged: npm run build && npx electron-builder --linux dir --publish never && PHARMACY_PACKAGED="$PWD/release/linux-unpacked/pharmacypos" xvfb-run -a node e2e/verify-desktop.mjs
